Fibric acid de- rivatives, statins, or nicotinic acid may be used. • ABNORMAL LIPOPROTEIN LIPASE FUNCTION (chylomicro- naemia). Drug therapy is largely ineffective, although fi- brates and nicotinic acid may have modest effects. The condition is treated with severe restriction of dietary fat; the diet may be supplemented by medium-chain triglyc- erides to improve tolerability, but their value is contro- versial.8 1.
